name: Zhejiang Golden Eagle Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Golden Eagle Co., Ltd., established in 1966 and headquartered in Zhoushan, China, operates primarily in the manufacturing and nationwide sale of textile products. The company's diverse textile offerings encompass knitted wear, woven apparel, and home furnishings, in addition to hybrid woven-knitted garments. They work with a wide range of materials, including silk, cashmere, linen, hemp, various yarns, and other fabric types. Beyond its textile operations, Zhejiang Golden Eagle also diversifies its business by producing machinery for plastic processing, die-casting, and the food industry. Furthermore, the company is involved in real estate development.
